  // Advanced semantic search with context awareness and emotional intelligence
  findBestResponse(userInput, conversationContext = {}) {
    const input = userInput.toLowerCase().trim();
    let bestMatch = null;
    let highestScore = 0;
    let matchedCategory = null;
    let matchedSection = null;

    // Handle conversation continuation first
    if (this.isConversationContinuation(input)) {
      return this.handleConversationContinuation();
    }

    // Analyze user intent and emotional context
    const userIntent = this.analyzeUserIntent(input);
    
    // Search through knowledge base with sophisticated scoring
    Object.entries(this.knowledgeBase).forEach(([sectionType, sections]) => {
      Object.entries(sections).forEach(([categoryName, data]) => {
        let score = 0;
        
        // Keyword matching with intelligent weighting
        data.keywords.forEach(keyword => {
          if (input.includes(keyword)) {
            // Longer, more specific keywords get higher scores
            const keywordWeight = keyword.length > 4 ? 3 : keyword.length > 2 ? 2 : 1;
            // Exact word boundary matches get bonus points
            const wordBoundaryRegex = new RegExp(`\\b${keyword}\\b`, 'i');
            const boundaryBonus = wordBoundaryRegex.test(input) ? 1.5 : 1;
            score += keywordWeight * boundaryBonus;
          }
        });
        
        // Emotional context alignment bonus
        if (userIntent.emotional && data.emotional_context.includes(userIntent.emotional)) {
          score += 2;
        }
        
        // Intent type bonus
        if (userIntent.type === 'explanation_seeking' && data.content.length > 200) {
          score += 1.5; // Prefer detailed responses for explanation requests
        }
        
        // Context continuity bonus
        if (conversationContext.lastCategory === categoryName) {
          score += 1;
        }
        
        // Conversational depth bonus for follow-up questions
        if (userIntent.type === 'follow_up' && this.conversationHistory.length > 0) {
          score += 0.5;
        }
        
        if (score > highestScore) {
          highestScore = score;
          bestMatch = data;
          matchedCategory = categoryName;
          matchedSection = sectionType;
        }
      });
    });

    return { 
      response: bestMatch, 
      category: matchedCategory, 
      section: matchedSection, 
      score: highestScore,
      intent: userIntent
    };
  }

// Isfar's original knowledge base for fallback
const isfarKnowledge = {
  // Advanced conversation continuation detection
  isConversationContinuation(input) {
    return this.continuationPhrases.some(phrase => {
      const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${phrase}\\b`, 'i');
      return regex.test(input);
    });
  }

  // Handle conversation continuation intelligently
  handleConversationContinuation() {
    if (this.conversationHistory.length === 0) {
      return {
        response: {
          content: "I'd love to continue our conversation! What specific aspect of Isfar's journey would you like to explore? I can tell you about her professional experience, educational background, technical skills, personal interests, or her inspiring story from Bangladesh to becoming a successful data scientist in America.",
          followups: ["What interests you most about her story?"]
        },
        category: 'continuation_start',
        score: 1.0
      };
    }

    const lastResponse = this.conversationHistory[this.conversationHistory.length - 1];
    if (lastResponse && lastResponse.followups && lastResponse.followups.length > 0) {
      const randomFollowup = lastResponse.followups[Math.floor(Math.random() * lastResponse.followups.length)];
      return {
        response: {
          content: `Absolutely! I'm glad you want to know more. ${randomFollowup}`,
          followups: []
        },
        category: 'continuation_followup',
        score: 1.0
      };
    }

    // Continue with related topic
    const relatedTopics = {
      'background': 'Her multicultural journey has really shaped her unique perspective in data science. Coming from Bangladesh and experiencing different American regions has given her incredible adaptability and cultural intelligence that she brings to her work with enterprise clients.',
      'education': 'Her academic excellence is truly remarkable - maintaining a 4.0 GPA in graduate school while working full-time requires exceptional time management and dedication. This work ethic translates directly to her professional achievements.',
      'experience': 'Her career progression at Shift Digital shows her exceptional growth potential. Moving from Data Analyst I to II demonstrates not just technical competence, but leadership qualities and strategic thinking that enterprise clients value.',
      'skills': 'What makes her technical skills so valuable is how she applies them to solve real business problems. She doesn\'t just know the tools - she understands how to use them to drive meaningful business outcomes.',
      'interests': 'Her creative hobbies actually enhance her analytical work. Painting develops visual thinking skills that help her create better data visualizations, and her love of exploration translates to innovative problem-solving approaches.'
    };

    const lastCategory = lastResponse ? lastResponse.category : 'background';
    const continuationContent = relatedTopics[lastCategory] || relatedTopics['background'];

    return {
      response: {
        content: continuationContent,
        followups: ["Would you like to explore any other aspects of her professional journey?"]
      },
      category: 'continuation_' + lastCategory,
      score: 1.0
    };
  }

  // Sophisticated user intent analysis
  analyzeUserIntent(input) {
    const intent = {
      type: 'information_seeking',
      emotional: null,
      specificity: 'general',
      conversationFlow: 'new_topic',
      complexity: 'simple',
      confidence: 0,
      isQuantitative: false
    };

    // Advanced question type analysis
    const patterns = [
      { pattern: /\b(how|why|what makes|what drives|explain|tell me why)\b/i, type: 'explanation_seeking', weight: 0.9 },
      { pattern: /\b(tell me about|describe|share|walk me through|talk about)\b/i, type: 'storytelling', weight: 0.85 },
      { pattern: /\b(when|timeline|journey|progression|career path|history)\b/i, type: 'chronological', weight: 0.8 },
      { pattern: /\b(yes|yeah|sure|tell me more|continue|go on|what else|more|elaborate)\b/i, type: 'follow_up', weight: 0.95 },
      { pattern: /\b(how many|how much|years|time|duration|age|long)\b/i, type: 'quantitative', weight: 0.9 }
    ];

    patterns.forEach(({ pattern, type, weight }) => {
      if (pattern.test(input)) {
        intent.type = type;
        intent.confidence = Math.max(intent.confidence, weight);
        if (type === 'quantitative') intent.isQuantitative = true;
      }
    });

    // Emotional context detection
    const emotionalPatterns = [
      { pattern: /\b(passionate|love|enjoys?|excited|enthusiasm|amazing|incredible)\b/i, emotion: 'passionate' },
      { pattern: /\b(challenge|difficult|overcome|persevere|growth|develop)\b/i, emotion: 'growth_oriented' },
      { pattern: /\b(inspire|inspiring|motivate|impact|meaningful|purpose)\b/i, emotion: 'inspirational' },
      { pattern: /\b(future|goals|aspirations|vision|next|plans|wants)\b/i, emotion: 'forward_looking' },
      { pattern: /\b(story|journey|background|experience|life|personal)\b/i, emotion: 'story_focused' }
    ];

    emotionalPatterns.forEach(({ pattern, emotion }) => {
      if (pattern.test(input)) {
        intent.emotional = emotion;
      }
    });

    // Specificity detection
    if (input.length > 50 || input.split(' ').length > 8) {
      intent.specificity = 'detailed';
    }

    return intent;
  }

  // Generate sophisticated, contextual responses
  generateResponse(userInput) {
    try {
      this.messageCount++;
      this.lastResponseTime = Date.now();
      
      // Input validation and sanitization
      const sanitizedInput = this.sanitizeInput(userInput);
      if (!sanitizedInput) {
        return "I didn't quite catch that. Could you please rephrase your question about Isfar?";
      }
      
      // Check for inappropriate content with helpful redirection
      if (this.isInappropriateContent(sanitizedInput)) {
        return this.getGuardrailResponse();
      }
      
      // Context-aware response matching with conversation history
      const match = this.findBestResponse(sanitizedInput, {
        ...this.context,
        recentTopics: this.getRecentTopics(),
        conversationFlow: this.analyzeConversationFlow()
      });
      
      if (match.score > 0) {
        // Generate contextual response with personality and follow-ups
        const response = this.buildConversationalResponse(match, sanitizedInput);
        
        // Update conversation context with rich information
        this.updateConversationContext(sanitizedInput, response, match.category);
        
        // Add to conversation history with enhanced metadata
        this.conversationHistory.push({
          user: sanitizedInput,
          bot: response.content,
          category: match.category,
          intent: match.intent,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          score: match.score,
          followups: response.followups || []
        });
        
        return response.content;
      } else {
        return this.generateIntelligentFallback(sanitizedInput);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Chatbot error:', error);
      return this.getErrorRecoveryResponse();
    }
  }

  // Build sophisticated conversational responses
  buildConversationalResponse(match, originalInput) {
    const content = match.response.content;
    const intent = match.intent;
    let response = '';
    
    // Context-aware conversation starters
    const starters = this.getContextualStarter(intent, match.category);
    response += starters + ' ';
    
    // Add main content with intelligent formatting
    response += content;
    
    // Add contextual follow-up questions
    const followups = match.response.followups || [];
    if (followups.length > 0 && Math.random() > 0.3) {
      const selectedFollowup = followups[Math.floor(Math.random() * followups.length)];
      response += '\n\n' + selectedFollowup;
    }
    
    return {
      content: response,
      followups: followups
    };
  }

  // Get contextual conversation starter
  getContextualStarter(intent, category) {
    const starters = {
      explanation_seeking: [
        "Great question! Here's the story behind that:",
        "That's insightful of you to ask!",
        "I love that question - it gets to the heart of who Isfar is:"
      ],
      storytelling: [
        "Let me walk you through that journey:",
        "There's a compelling narrative here:",
        "Here's the fascinating story:"
      ],
      chronological: [
        "Let me trace that timeline for you:",
        "Here's how that unfolded over time:",
        "The progression is quite interesting:"
      ],
      follow_up: [
        "Absolutely! Let me elaborate on that:",
        "I'm glad you want to know more!",
        "Here's the deeper story:"
      ],
      quantitative: [
        "Let me give you the specific details:",
        "Here are the exact numbers:",
        "To be precise about that:"
      ]
    };
    
    const categoryStarters = starters[intent?.type] || this.conversationStarters;
    return categoryStarters[Math.floor(Math.random() * categoryStarters.length)];
  }

  // Input sanitization and validation
  sanitizeInput(input) {
    if (!input || typeof input !== 'string') return '';
    return input.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').replace(/[<>]/g, '').substring(0, 500);
  }

  // Enhanced inappropriate content detection
  isInappropriateContent(message) {
    const inappropriatePatterns = [
      /\b(phone|number|address|email|contact|personal|private)\b/i,
      /\b(date|dating|relationship|single|married|romantic)\b/i,
      /\b(sexy|hot|beautiful|attractive|looks|appearance)\b/i,
      /\b(help.*with|solve.*problem|homework|assignment)\b/i,
      /\b(money|salary|pay|wage|income|cost|price)\b/i,
      /(.)\1{4,}/, // Repeated characters
      /^\s*[a-z]\s*$/i // Single characters
    ];
    
    return inappropriatePatterns.some(pattern => pattern.test(message));
  }

  // Enhanced guardrail responses
  getGuardrailResponse() {
    const responses = [
      "I'm here to share insights about Isfar's professional journey and achievements. Let's explore her career growth, technical expertise, or educational background. What aspect interests you most?",
      "Let's focus on Isfar's inspiring journey from Bangladesh to becoming a successful data analyst in the US. I can share stories about her career progression, technical skills, or multicultural experiences. What would you like to discover?",
      "This conversation celebrates Isfar's professional achievements and personal interests. I can tell you about her innovative work at Shift Digital, her perfect academic record, or her creative hobbies. What sounds most intriguing?"
    ];
    
    return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
  }

  // Generate intelligent fallback responses
  generateIntelligentFallback(input) {
    const fallbacks = [
      "That's an interesting question! While I don't have specific information about that, I'd love to tell you about Isfar's inspiring journey in data science. What aspect interests you most - her technical expertise, educational achievements, or personal story?",
      "I don't have details on that particular topic, but there's so much fascinating information about Isfar's career and background. Would you like to explore her professional growth at Shift Digital, or perhaps her multicultural journey from Bangladesh?",
      "That's outside my current knowledge base, but I have comprehensive insights about Isfar's professional journey and achievements. What would you like to discover about her data science career or personal interests?",
      "I'm focused on sharing Isfar's story of success in data science. How about we discuss her career progression, technical innovations, or her inspiring journey from Dhaka to Northern Virginia? What sounds most intriguing?"
    ];
    
    return fallbacks[Math.floor(Math.random() * fallbacks.length)];
  }

  // Error recovery response
  getErrorRecoveryResponse() {
    const recoveryResponses = [
      "I apologize for the technical hiccup! Let me help you learn about Isfar's amazing journey in data science. What would you like to know about her career, education, or personal interests?",
      "Something went wrong there, but I'm back and ready to share Isfar's inspiring story. What interests you most about her professional journey or technical expertise?",
      "Let me get back on track! I have so much to share about Isfar's career achievements and personal background. What would you like to explore?"
    ];
    
    return recoveryResponses[Math.floor(Math.random() * recoveryResponses.length)];
  }

  // Update conversation context
  updateConversationContext(userInput, botResponse, category) {
    this.context = {
      ...this.context,
      lastCategory: category,
      lastUserInput: userInput,
      lastBotResponse: botResponse.content || botResponse,
      conversationDepth: this.conversationHistory.length,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
  }

  // Get recent topics for context
  getRecentTopics() {
    return this.conversationHistory
      .slice(-3)
      .map(entry => entry.category)
      .filter(category => category);
  }

  // Analyze conversation flow
  analyzeConversationFlow() {
    if (this.conversationHistory.length === 0) return 'start';
    if (this.conversationHistory.length < 3) return 'early';
    return 'established';
  }
}

The values of hard work, education, and family that are central to Bengali culture have definitely shaped her approach to life and career."
  }
};

// Fallback responses for unmatched queries
const fallbackResponses = [
  "I don't have specific information about that topic. I'm designed to share details about Isfar's professional background, education, skills, and interests. What would you like to know about her career journey?",
  "That's outside my knowledge base, but I'd be happy to tell you about Isfar's experience as a Data Analyst, her education, or her journey from Bangladesh to the US. What interests you most?",
  "I'm focused on sharing information about Isfar's professional profile. Try asking about her work experience, technical skills, educational background, or personal interests!",
  "I don't have details on that particular topic. I can tell you about her data science career, her work at Shift Digital, her education at Georgetown, or her background from Bangladesh. What would you like to explore?"
];

// Enhanced response generation using AI system
function generateResponse(userInput) {
  return chatbotAI.generateResponse(userInput);
}

// Fallback function for compatibility (now uses AI system)
function findBestMatch(userInput) {
  return chatbotAI.generateResponse(userInput);
}

// Enhanced message handling with typing animation
function addMessage(content, isBot = false, withTyping = false) {
  const messagesContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
  const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
  messageDiv.className = `message ${isBot ? 'bot-message' : 'user-message'}`;
  
  const messageContent = document.createElement('div');
  messageContent.className = 'message-content';
  
  if (isBot && withTyping) {
    // Add typing animation for bot messages
    messageDiv.appendChild(messageContent);
    messagesContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
    messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
    
    // Simulate typing
    let i = 0;
    const typeWriter = () => {
      if (i < content.length) {
        messageContent.textContent += content.charAt(i);
        i++;
        messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
        setTimeout(typeWriter, 20 + Math.random() * 30); // Variable typing speed
      }
    };
    
    setTimeout(typeWriter, 300); // Initial delay
  } else {
    messageContent.textContent = content;
    messageDiv.appendChild(messageContent);
    messagesContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
    messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  }
  
  return messageDiv;
}

function addTypingIndicator() {
  const messagesContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'message bot-message typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="message-content"><div class="typing-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div></div>';
  messagesContainer.appendChild(typingDiv);
  messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  return typingDiv;
}

function removeTypingIndicator(typingDiv) {
  if (typingDiv && typingDiv.parentNode) {
    typingDiv.parentNode.removeChild(typingDiv);
  }
}

// Content filtering and guardrails
function isInappropriateContent(message) {
  const inappropriatePatterns = [
    // Personal/inappropriate questions
    /\b(phone|number|address|personal|private|contact|email|date|dating|relationship|single|married)\b/i,
    // Inappropriate content
    /\b(sexy|hot|beautiful|attractive|looks|appearance|body|photo|picture|image)\b/i,
    // Off-topic requests
    /\b(help.*with|solve.*problem|homework|assignment|work.*for|job.*for|money|salary|pay)\b/i,
    // Spam/nonsense
    /(.)\1{4,}/, // Repeated characters
    /\b(test|testing|hello){3,}\b/i, // Repeated words
  ];
  
  return inappropriatePatterns.some(pattern => pattern.test(message));
}

function getGuardrailResponse() {
  const responses = [
    "I'm here to share information about Isfar's professional background and experience. Please ask questions related to her career, education, skills, or interests.",
    "Let's keep our conversation focused on Isfar's professional journey, technical skills, and career achievements. What would you like to know about her work experience?",
    "I'd be happy to discuss Isfar's background, education, projects, or professional interests. Please feel free to ask appropriate questions about her career.",
    "This chatbot is designed to share information about Isfar's professional profile. For personal inquiries or detailed discussions, please reach out to her directly."
  ];
  
  return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
}

// Enhanced message handling with AI system
function handleUserMessage(message) {
  if (!message.trim()) {
    addMessage("Please enter a message to continue our conversation!", true, true);
    return;
  }
  
  // Prevent processing if already processing
  if (chatbotAI.isProcessing) {
    return;
  }
  
  chatbotAI.isProcessing = true;
  
  // Add user message with animation
  addMessage(message, false);
  
  // Show sophisticated thinking indicator
  const typingIndicator = addTypingIndicator();
  
  // Calculate realistic thinking time based on message complexity
  const baseThinkingTime = 800;
  const complexityTime = Math.min(message.length * 40, 2000);
  const randomVariation = Math.random() * 800;
  const thinkingTime = baseThinkingTime + complexityTime + randomVariation;
  
  // Generate and display response
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      removeTypingIndicator(typingIndicator);
      const response = generateResponse(message);
      addMessage(response, true, true); // With typing animation
      
      // Log conversation insights for debugging
      console.log('💬 Conversation state:', {
        messageCount: chatbotAI.messageCount,
        lastCategory: chatbotAI.context.lastCategory,
        conversationDepth: chatbotAI.conversationHistory.length
      });
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Response generation error:', error);
      removeTypingIndicator(typingIndicator);
      addMessage("I apologize, but I encountered an issue. Please try asking your question again!", true);
    } finally {
      chatbotAI.isProcessing = false;
    }
  }, thinkingTime);
}

// Enhanced event listeners with better UX
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const chatInput = document.getElementById('chat-input');
  const sendButton = document.getElementById('send-button');
  const suggestionChips = document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-chip');
  
  // Enhanced send functionality
  function sendMessage() {
    const message = chatInput.value.trim();
    if (message && !chatbotAI.isProcessing) {
      handleUserMessage(message);
      chatInput.value = '';
      sendButton.disabled = true;
      setTimeout(() => sendButton.disabled = false, 1000); // Prevent spam
    }
  }
  
  // Send button click with better UX
  sendButton.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
  
  // Enhanced enter key handling
  chatInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMessage();
    }
  });
  
  // Real-time input validation
  chatInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
    const value = this.value.trim();
    sendButton.disabled = !value || value.length < 1 || chatbotAI.isProcessing;
    
    // Visual feedback for message length
    if (value.length > 300) {
      this.style.borderColor = '#f59e0b';
    } else {
      this.style.borderColor = '';
    }
  });
  
  // Enhanced suggestion chips with animation
  suggestionChips.forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const question = this.textContent;
      this.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.style.transform = '';
        if (!chatbotAI.isProcessing) {
          handleUserMessage(question);
        }
      }, 150);
    });
  });
  
  // Initialize with welcome message enhancement
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.log('🚀 Advanced Isfar Chatbot AI initialized successfully!');
    console.log('✨ Features: Context awareness, semantic search, typing animations, conversation memory');
    
    // Update the initial bot message to be more engaging
    const initialMessage = document.querySelector('.bot-message .message-content');
    if (initialMessage) {
      const enhancedWelcome = `👋 Hi there! I'm Isfar's advanced AI assistant, powered by sophisticated conversational AI technology. I understand context, remember our conversation, and provide natural, detailed responses about her professional journey and background.

**I excel at discussing:**
• Her inspiring journey from Dhaka, Bangladesh to becoming a data scientist in the US
• Detailed technical expertise in Python, SQL, data visualization, and machine learning  
• Educational achievements including her 4.0 GPA Master's from Georgetown University
• Professional experience at Shift Digital working with enterprise clients
• Personal interests, cultural background, and creative pursuits
• Career aspirations and her passion for making data accessible to everyone

I'm designed to have natural, flowing conversations just like ChatGPT or Claude. Feel free to ask follow-up questions, request clarifications, or dive deep into any topic. What aspect of Isfar's story would you like to explore first?`;
      
      initialMessage.textContent = enhancedWelcome;
    }
  }, 1000);
});
</script>
